title: Nouns of Place, Time, Instrument & Diminutives
source: Original instructional lesson authored for this application (syllabus ref: Haywood & Nahmad Ch. 39; Ryding Ch. 5)
objectives: Derive nouns of place and time (مَفْعَلٌ / مَفْعِلٌ) from triliteral roots.
Recognize nouns of instrument (مِفْعَالٌ, مِفْعَلٌ, مِفْعَلَةٌ).
Form diminutives (فُعَيْلٌ / فُعَيْعِلٌ) used for smallness, endearment, or rhetorical nuance.
recallPrompt: From Chapter 7: What broken plural pattern do nouns like مَسْجِدٌ and مِفْتَاحٌ form?

sections.heading: Locative, Instrumental & Diminutive Morphology
sections.body: Prefixing مَـ to a triliteral root creates a noun of place or time (ism makān wa-zamān); prefixing مِـ creates a noun of instrument (ism al-ālah); and inserting ـيْـ after C2 with ḍammah on C1 creates a diminutive (ism al-taṣghīr).

sections.label: Derived Noun Patterns
sections.summary: Place/Time: مَفْعِلٌ if the Form I imperfect has kasrah (يَجْلِسُ → مَجْلِسٌ) or is assimilated (و-ق-ف → مَوْقِفٌ); otherwise مَفْعَلٌ (يَكْتُبُ → مَكْتَبٌ). Instrument: مِفْعَالٌ (مِفْتَاحٌ), مِفْعَلٌ (مِبْرَدٌ), مِفْعَلَةٌ (مِكْنَسَةٌ). Diminutive: فُعَيْلٌ (كُتَيِّبٌ, بُنَيٌّ).

sections.translation: O my dear little son, enter the mosque.
sections.irab: يَا: حَرْفُ نِدَاءٍ | بُنَيَّ: مُنَادًى مُضَافٌ مَنْصُوبٌ (تَصْغِيرُ ابْنٍ) | المَسْجِدَ: مَفْعُولٌ بِهِ مَنْصُوبٌ
sections.notes: بُنَيَّ is the diminutive of ابْنٌ ('son') + 1s suffix ـي, expressing tender affection in classical prose and scripture.

sections.heading: Distinguish مَـ (Place) from مِـ (Instrument)
sections.body: Nouns of place/time start with fatḥah (مَـ: مَسْجِدٌ, مَكْتَبٌ); nouns of instrument start with kasrah (مِـ: مِفْتَاحٌ, مِيزَانٌ).
